name: Birsha
overview: Birsha was a king of Gomorrah who, along with other regional kings, engaged in conflict as described in Genesis 14. These kings initially served under Chedorlaomer for twelve years before rebelling in the thirteenth year. The subsequent military campaigns led by Chedorlaomer and his allies involved battles across various territories, highlighting the political and military turmoil of the time. Birsha's role as a king in this coalition underscores the historical context of Gomorrah prior to its later judgment.
